items.title: The Unmet Driver
items.question: I steer your choices but never introduce myself; therapists hunt me for decades while mirrors miss me entirely. What am I?
items.hintText:
Therapists hunt me for decades.
Mirrors never show my face.
Your choices obey what you never met.
items.correctExplanation: The unconscious — steering without introducing, hunted by therapy, missed by mirrors. The driver never met.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is the unconscious. Steer-without-introducing plus therapy-hunted plus mirror-missed isolates the hidden mind: choices obey a stranger within. Never-met drivers steer most surely.
items.lessonContent:
Never-met drivers steer most surely.
Therapy hunts what mirrors miss.
Choices obey strangers within.
Hidden minds outvote visible ones.
Share this: meet one hidden driver.

items.title: The Humble Middle
items.question: Students gain me; scholars lose me. The more you truly learn, the smaller I grow. What am I?
items.hintText:
Beginners brim with me.
Scholars shed me steadily.
Learning shrinks what ignorance inflates.
items.correctExplanation: Certainty — inflated by ignorance, deflated by learning. Knowing grows as certainty shrinks.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is certainty. Gain-with-schooling then loss-with-scholarship traces Dunning-Kruger slopes: peaks of confidence precede valleys of understanding. Inflated beginnings, humble middles.
items.lessonContent:
Humble middles follow confident peaks.
Ignorance inflates what learning deflates.
Slopes of confidence trace understanding.
Shrinking marks growing, paradoxically.
Share this: shrink one confidence deliberately.

items.title: The Room's Beast
items.question: Everyone sees me but no one mentions me; meetings orbit around what all pretend is absent. What fills the room unsaid?
items.hintText:
All eyes avoid what all see.
Meetings orbit my absence.
Naming me breaks the spell.
items.correctExplanation: The elephant in the room — collectively seen, collectively unsaid. Presence acknowledged by avoidance.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is the elephant in the room. Seen-by-all plus mentioned-by-none plus orbited-around isolates the open secret: avoidance acknowledges what speech denies. Spells break at naming.
items.lessonContent:
Avoidance acknowledges what speech denies.
Collective silence signals shared sight.
Orbits reveal unspoken centers.
Naming breaks carefully kept spells.
Share this: name one room-beast gently.

items.title: The Announced Death
items.question: Plan me aloud and I perish; sprung unannounced, I delight. Wrapping paper is my armor. What am I?
items.hintText:
Announcement kills me instantly.
Wrapping paper armors my arrival.
Unannounced, I delight completely.
items.correctExplanation: Surprise — dying when announced, delighting when sprung. Foreknowledge is fatal to wonder.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is surprise. Plan-aloud-perishes plus sprung-delights plus wrapping-armor isolates the unexpected: knowledge beforehand assassinates delight. Armor made of paper guards best.
items.lessonContent:
Foreknowledge assassinates delight reliably.
Paper armor guards wonders best.
Announcement kills what secrecy saves.
Unexpected delights need unknowing hosts.
Share this: spring one delight unannounced.

items.title: The Growing Hunger
items.question: Answers feed me yet I grow hungrier; the wisest confess me daily while fools deny my existence. What am I?
items.hintText:
Answers feed but never fill me.
The wise confess me daily.
Fools deny I exist at all.
items.correctExplanation: Wonder — fed by answers, confessed by sages, denied by fools. Hunger growing with meals.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is wonder. Feed-yet-hungrier plus wise-confessed plus fool-denied isolates philosophical appetite: eating whets, never sates. Meals multiply the hunger they feed.
items.lessonContent:
Meals multiply hungers they feed.
Confessed appetites mark sages truly.
Denied hungers mark fools reliably.
Eating whets philosophical appetites.
Share this: confess one hunger today.

items.title: The Self Describer
items.question: I hide answers inside questions and crown solvers with aha. You are solving me right now. What am I?
items.hintText:
Questions house my answers.
Solvers earn aha from me.
You are inside me now.
items.correctExplanation: Riddle — hiding answers in questions, crowning solvers, being solved now. Self-description completed.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is riddle. Hide-in-questions plus crown-with-aha plus solving-now isolates metas: the puzzle describing itself. Readers stand inside the answer.
items.lessonContent:
Questions can house their own answers.
Solvers live inside some puzzles.
Aha crowns the self-described.
Meta solved is mastery doubled.
Share this: solve one self-describer.

items.title: The Priceless Currency
items.question: I increase when given away yet cannot be bought at any price; broken once, I take years to re-mint. What am I?
items.hintText:
Giving multiplies my supply.
No price purchases me anywhere.
One break costs years of minting.
items.correctExplanation: Trust — multiplied by giving, unbuyable at price, slowly re-minted. Currency no treasury prints.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is trust. Give-away-grows plus unbuyable plus slow-remint isolates relational capital: spent freely, earned slowly, broken instantly. Treasuries print money, never this.
items.lessonContent:
Relational capital mints slowly always.
Spent freely, earned over years.
Broken instantly, rebuilt over decades.
Unbuyable goods beat priced ones.
Share this: spend one confidence wisely.

items.title: The Unseen Observer
items.question: I observe everything except the observer; turn me upon myself and I vanish into recursion. What am I?
items.hintText:
All things appear within me.
The observer alone escapes my view.
Self-turning dissolves into recursion.
items.correctExplanation: Consciousness — observing all but its observer, recursing when self-turned. The eye that cannot see itself seeing.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is consciousness. Observe-all-but-observer plus self-turn-recursion isolates awareness: spotlight illuminating everything except its source. Eyes see everything but seeing.
items.lessonContent:
Spotlights miss their own sources.
Self-turning dissolves into recursion.
Eyes see everything but seeing.
Observers escape all observations.
Share this: watch one watcher fail.

items.title: The Distant Sharpener
items.question: I blur up close and clarify with distance; the grieving need me most yet reach me last. Time is my lens grinder. What am I?
items.hintText:
Closeness blurs what distance sharpens.
The grieving reach me last of all.
Time grinds all my lenses.
items.correctExplanation: Perspective — blurred near, sharp far, ground by time. Distance develops what proximity overexposes.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is perspective. Blur-near plus sharpen-far plus time-ground isolates viewpoint-with-distance: grief needs what only years deliver. Lenses need temporal grinding.
items.lessonContent:
Distance develops overexposed pains.
Grief needs years to focus.
Lenses grind slowly, never instantly.
Near blurs; far clarifies reliably.
Share this: step back from one pain.

items.title: The Defeated Sentence
items.question: Utter me truly and I become false; deny me and I may turn true. Logicians quarantine me in hierarchies. What am I?
items.hintText:
True utterance makes me false.
Denial may restore my truth.
Logicians cage me in levels.
items.correctExplanation: The liar paradox — 'this sentence is false' oscillates truthfully. Self-reference defeats bivalence elegantly.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is the liar paradox. Utter-true-becomes-false plus hierarchies-quarantine isolates self-referential collapse: levels upon levels contain what flat truth cannot. Oscillation is the verdict.
items.lessonContent:
Self-reference collapses flat truth.
Hierarchies quarantine oscillating sentences.
Oscillation verdicts beat true-false ones.
Levels contain what planes cannot.
Share this: utter one defeater.

items.title: The Hunted Rest
items.question: Chase me and I flee; abandon the hunt and I arrive. Insomniacs know my cruelty best. What am I?
items.hintText:
Pursuit repels me nightly.
Abandoned hunts summon my arrival.
Counters of sheep know my cruelty.
items.correctExplanation: Sleep — fleeing chasers, arriving for abandoners. Effort is the repellent; surrender the invitation.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is sleep. Chase-flees plus abandon-arrives isolates effort-inverted goods: trying wakes, releasing rests. Insomniacs demonstrate the paradox nightly.
items.lessonContent:
Effort repels what surrender invites.
Trying wakes; releasing rests reliably.
Inverted goods punish pursuit directly.
Abandon hunts to receive arrivals.
Share this: abandon one chase tonight.

items.title: The Silent Accuser
items.question: I speak loudest when nothing sounds; criminals hear me clearest after midnight. No court summons me, yet all stand trial. What am I?
items.hintText:
Midnight amplifies my voice most.
Criminals hear me without summons.
Silence is my favorite courtroom.
items.correctExplanation: Conscience — loudest in silence, midnight counsel, unsummoned judge. Courts adjourn; this one never does.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is conscience. Speak-in-silence plus criminal-audience plus no-summons isolates inner judgment: guilt's own tribunal convenes nightly. Verdicts without plaintiffs convict reliably.
items.lessonContent:
Inner tribunals convene nightly always.
Verdicts without plaintiffs convict reliably.
Silence amplifies unspoken charges.
Midnight counsel needs no summons.
Share this: hear one silent charge.

items.title: The Ancient Post
items.question: I left my source before empires rose and arrive long after it died; astronomers read me like old mail. What am I?
items.hintText:
Empires rose and fell during my trip.
My source died before my arrival.
Telescopes read me like old letters.
items.correctExplanation: Starlight — posted before empires, delivered after sources died. Mail slower than history itself.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is starlight. Leave-before-empires plus arrive-after-death plus telescope-read isolates light-travel time: the sky is a museum of departed suns. Post slower than history amazes.
items.lessonContent:
Skies museum departed suns nightly.
Post outlasts senders by eons here.
Telescopes read mail, not just light.
History runs slower than rumored.
Share this: read one ancient letter.

items.title: The Printed Doom
items.question: Foretell disaster and crowds will enact it; publish panic and markets will perform it. What comes true because it was foretold?
items.hintText:
Foretelling enacts what it predicts.
Published panic performs itself.
Crowds obey printed dooms.
items.correctExplanation: Self-fulfilling prophecy — foretold disasters enacted by believers. Predictions that manufacture their evidence.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is self-fulfilling prophecy. Foretell-enacts plus publish-performs isolates reflexive prediction: belief builds the foretold world. Dooms print their own tickets.
items.lessonContent:
Beliefs build foretold worlds reliably.
Reflexive predictions manufacture evidence.
Dooms print their own tickets.
Crowds enact printed disasters.
Share this: foretell one flourishing.

items.title: The Last Doubter
items.question: Doubt everything — senses, math, memory — and one doubter remains standing who cannot be doubted away. Who survives universal skepticism?
items.hintText:
Senses fall first to doubt.
Math and memory follow after.
One doubter cannot be doubted away.
items.correctExplanation: The thinker — doubting presupposes a doubter: Cogito's survivor. Skepticism consumes everything but its consumer.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is the thinker. Doubt-all leaves doubting intact: the act refutes its own denial. Consumers survive what consumption devours.
items.lessonContent:
Acts refute their own denials.
Consumers survive consumption always.
Doubting presupposes doubters necessarily.
Last standers found philosophies.
Share this: doubt one doubt away.

items.title: The Plain Hider
items.question: I hide best where everyone looks; search parties march straight past me daily. Detectives call me the purloined kind. What am I?
items.hintText:
Searchers march straight past me.
Everyone looks where I hide.
Poe named my purloined kind.
items.correctExplanation: The obvious — hiding where everyone looks, marched past daily. Plainness camouflages perfectly.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is the obvious. March-past plus look-where-hides plus Poe-named isolates plain-sight concealment: purloined letters sit in card racks. Hunters overlook the unhidden.
items.lessonContent:
Openness hides better than shadows.
Everyone looks where secrets sit.
Purloined kinds mock all hunters.
Plainness camouflages perfectly.
Share this: see one plain hider.

items.title: The Solved Death
items.question: Pursue me and I deepen; solve me and I perish. Detectives kill me professionally. What am I?
items.hintText:
Pursuit deepens what solving kills.
Detectives murder me for pay.
Answers are my autopsy reports.
items.correctExplanation: Mystery — deepened by pursuit, killed by solution. Autopsies called answers end the living question.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is mystery. Pursue-deepens plus solve-perishes isolates inquiry's quarry: living questions die dissected. Detectives are licensed killers of wonder.
items.lessonContent:
Living questions die dissected.
Answers autopsy what wonder sustained.
Pursuit deepens; solution ends.
Licensed killers serve curiosity.
Share this: sustain one unknown.

items.title: The Halved Burden
items.question: Share me and I halve; hoard me and I double. Friends lighten what solitude magnifies. What am I?
items.hintText:
Sharing halves my weight exactly.
Hoarding doubles every load.
Solitude magnifies what friends lighten.
items.correctExplanation: Sorrow — halved in sharing, doubled in hoarding. Arithmetic of hearts defies mathematics.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is sorrow. Share-halves plus hoard-doubles isolates grief's economy: division multiplies relief. Friends are denominators of pain.
items.lessonContent:
Division multiplies relief reliably.
Friends denominator all pains.
Hoarding doubles; sharing halves.
Heart arithmetic defies mathematics.
Share this: halve one burden today.

items.title: The Packed Wisdom
items.question: I say most with fewest words; fools need volumes where I need lines. Carved in stone, I outlast libraries. What am I?
items.hintText:
Fewest words carry my most meaning.
Volumes fail where lines succeed.
Stone preserves what libraries lose.
items.correctExplanation: Proverb — maximum meaning, minimum words, stone-duration. Compression perfected over centuries.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is proverb. Most-with-fewest plus stone-outlasting isolates compressed wisdom: centuries distill lines libraries cannot hold. Brevity is the distillation.
items.lessonContent:
Centuries distill lines libraries miss.
Brevity is distillation perfected.
Stone outlasts paper for essentials.
Fewest words carry most meaning.
Share this: carve one line wisely.

items.title: The Dismissed Prophet
items.question: Cursed to prophesy truly and never be believed, I watch Troy burn exactly as foretold. Priests dismiss me; fires vindicate me. Who am I?
items.hintText:
True prophecies earn me dismissal.
Troy burns exactly as I foretold.
Priests wave away my warnings.
items.correctExplanation: Cassandra — truly prophesying, never believed, vindicated by flames. Apollo's gift wrapped in curse.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is Cassandra. True-foretold plus never-believed plus Troy-burned isolates the cursed prophetess: gift and curse in one utterance. Fires review what priests rejected.
items.lessonContent:
Gifts wrapped in curses confuse all.
Fires review rejected warnings finally.
True foretelling earns dismissal often.
Curses hide inside blessings here.
Share this: heed one dismissed voice.

items.title: The Sought Absence
items.question: Seek me and I retreat; surrender the search and I arrive. Losing the little self finds the boundless one. What am I?
items.hintText:
Seeking repels my arrival daily.
Surrender summons what chasing scatters.
Little selves block boundless ones.
items.correctExplanation: Enlightenment — retreating from seekers, arriving for surrenderers. The found is the unfound-by-trying.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is enlightenment. Seek-retreats plus surrender-arrives isolates awakening's paradox: grasping hands close around air. Boundlessness admits the selfless only.
items.lessonContent:
Grasping closes around air always.
Surrender summons what chasing scatters.
Boundlessness admits selfless seekers.
Unfound-by-trying defines arrival.
Share this: surrender one search today.

items.title: The Oldest Newborn
items.question: I am the oldest day you'll never see again and the newest you will ever have. Yesterday envies me; tomorrow borrows from me. What am I?
items.hintText:
Never-seen-again meets never-had-yet.
Yesterday envies my position.
Tomorrow borrows all my hours.
items.correctExplanation: Today — oldest in passing, newest in having. The hinge day envied behind and borrowed ahead.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is today. Oldest-never-again plus newest-ever-had isolates the present hinge: behind envies, ahead borrows. Days pivot on this one.
items.lessonContent:
Hinges pivot pasts and futures.
Behind envies; ahead borrows constantly.
Oldest passing meets newest having.
Pivot days deserve full presence.
Share this: inhabit one hinge fully.

items.title: The False Memory
items.question: I feel exactly like remembering something that never happened; travelers know me in streets they've never walked. What am I?
items.hintText:
Unwalked streets feel well-trodden.
Never-happened feels remembered.
Travelers meet me most often.
items.correctExplanation: Déjà vu — familiarity without history, recognition without source. Memory's misfire feels like its function.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is déjà vu. Unwalked-familiar plus never-happened-remembered isolates false recognition: glitch or signal, science still debates. Feeling certain proves nothing here.
items.lessonContent:
Familiarity without history misleads.
Recognition needs sources to trust.
Glitches mimic functions perfectly.
Certainty proves nothing alone.
Share this: doubt one familiarity.

items.title: The Tongueless Choir
items.question: No tongue, yet every nation understands; no lessons needed where I play. What needs no translation?
items.hintText:
Nations understand without lessons.
Tongues never shape my phrases.
Translation is meaningless to me.
items.correctExplanation: Music — tongueless choir understood worldwide. Phrases beyond all grammars.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is music. No-tongue plus every-nation plus no-lessons isolates the universal art: grammars divide, melodies unite. Translation dies where music speaks.
items.lessonContent:
Melodies unite where grammars divide.
Universal arts need no tongues.
Lessons unnecessary mark true universals.
Phrases beyond grammar persuade all.
Share this: hum one universal tonight.

items.title: The Loud Quiet
items.question: I fill rooms the moment conversation dies; hosts dread my arrival while philosophers praise my honesty. What am I?
items.hintText:
Dying talk summons me instantly.
Hosts dread what thinkers praise.
Rooms fill with my emptiness.
items.correctExplanation: Awkward silence — filling dead conversation, dreaded by hosts, praised by philosophers. Emptiness with volume.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is awkward silence. Conversation-dies-arrives plus hosts-dread plus thinkers-praise isolates social quiet: honesty too loud for comfort. Volumes of nothing deafen politely.
items.lessonContent:
Honesty too loud discomforts politely.
Dead talk summons full emptiness.
Dreaded by hosts, praised by sages.
Volumes of nothing deafen rooms.
Share this: endure one loud quiet.
